name: Vitor Cecchinato
bio: Vitor is an aspiring filmmaker and director of live events at an award winning TV production program. He has wanted to make films since living in Brazil the age of 5. This has led to a life long interest that blossomed into infatuation with the medium, certainly bolstered by his moving to the US making it more accessible. Vitor’s obsession with filmmaking has led to his participation within the awards space, joining the Fantasy Filmball server in the middle of 2025. While Vitor may be known for some out-there takes, his passion for film and writing has led to his participation within the Fantasy Filmball writing team. Follow him on Awards Expert: @developingfilm
